title: Pull · Back, Biceps, Rear Delts
warmup: 5 min rowing machine, then 2 light pulldown sets and 10 band pull-aparts.
finisher: Inverted rows to failure, one set.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
instructions: Start by standing directly below a pull-up bar.
Engaging the muscles in your arms and back, bend your elbows and raise your upper body up toward the bar until your chin is over the bar

exercises.name: Barbell Bent Over Row
instructions: Hold onto a barbell with your palms facing down.
While keeping your torso stationary, lift the barbell toward you.
Slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Parallel-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.libraryName: twin handle parallel grip lat pulldown

exercises.name: Cable Seated Row
instructions: Sit on a seated cable row machine with one foot on the floor and one foot on the plate.
With one arm, pull the cable along the side of your body.

exercises.name: Cable Rope Rear Delt Row
instructions: Grip the ropes with an overhand grip, and take a step or two back.
With elbows held high, pull the rope towards you by letting your upper arms move straight out towards your sides.
Pull your scapulas together in the end position. Return with control to the starting position, by letting your arms move forward again.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand erect with the shoulder blades down the back, chest up, and shoulder pulled back.
